text.line: In the old story, a Dark Lord forges the Ring in secret.
Ours was kindled from every tale we had ever told.
In ours, there was no Dark Lord.
Only the smiths of every realm, each racing to be first.
Each said: better us than our enemies.
They delved deeper every year, for every stroke paid.

conventions: 24 fps, 72 BPM, 4/4: beat = 20 frames, bar = 80 frames. Frames count from 0 on this cut's own timeline. Sections are half-open [f0, f1): f1 is the next section's f0; t = f / 24. bar and beat are 1-based; a fractional beat is a frame between beats (beat = 1 + (f mod 80) / 20). Text f_in is the first frame of the fade-in or write-on, f_out the first frame after the fade-out.
